name: RSI-pullback re-entry in an uptrend — buy-the-dip continuation (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM (distinct from reversion): in a CONFIRMED uptrend (positive trailing ret_Nd + high adx), a shallow RSI pullback is a liquidity event where trend-followers add and stopped-out shorts cover — price resumes up. The counterparty is short-term reversal traders who fade strength and get run over on the resumption. This is 'momentum with a better entry': the pullback lowers cost basis so the net-of-fee edge widens vs chasing the high. 15m gives enough pullback frequency without 1m-level fee churn. Entry: rsi below a fitted dip floor (mild pullback, NOT washout) AND positive ret_Nd AND adx above a floor (uptrend intact). Exit on stop/TP/time or rsi crossing back up through a fitted resumption level. DISCONFIRMER: kill if the edge survives with the uptrend gate REMOVED (then it is really a reversion trade misfiled here — reversion is largely arbitraged away in crypto), or if it also wins as an RSI-overbought SHORT (rsi acting as pure reversion, not continuation). It must ONLY work as a dip-BUY conditional on positive ret_Nd + high adx.
catalyst: shallow RSI dip inside a confirmed uptrend
